items:
Horizon is a designer-grade beach home boasting stunning ocean views from its 4 story al-fresco covered dining deck.

Private, gated beach access for a less-crowded beach experience.

Features ocean views from its living room, dining and kitchen.

Located directly on Florida’s famous scenic 30A and its 17 mile coastal bike path.

Includes free 2023 6 seater golf cart, grill, 2 paddleboards.

Covered, seasonally-heated (between October 1 and April 30), private pool.

Boasting 7 bedrooms each with its own personal bath, Horizon offers a large 16 person sleeping capacity while maintaining its designer-curated, coastal-elite style.

Looking for a more relaxing, less-crowded beach experience? Horizon’s private beach gate is directly across the street (only 50 feet away) from the property’s edge. With access limited only to the surrounding neighbors, Horizon’s private beach assures you of the quiet enjoyment of the wide white, sugar sand beaches and crystal clear emerald waters that makes our area famous!

Of course, variety is the spice of life and with over 10 public beaches within 2 miles of Horizon, you’ll never run short of options to soak up the sun.

But, when you’ve had enough of the sun, you can still enjoy the water in Horizon’s covered pool. Yep, no need to tell the kiddos that they can’t play in the pool because they’ve had enough sun today. Horizon’s gated, covered pool allows everyone to enjoy the water longer without concern of being overexposed.

In the evening, savor the coastal breeze and panoramic ocean view from Horizon’s covered 4th story covered deck.

Not a worn out rental. With its construction just completed in 2023, Horizon boasts the latest features to assure your comfort and convenience…not to mention designer-grade furnishings, premium mattresses, and state of the art appliances and bedding.

Planning a special meal for the entire group? Awesome! Horizon offers 17 person simultaneous indoor dining plus ample balcony seating. (And did we mention that the family chef can enjoy the ocean view from Horizon’s quartz kitchen while whipping up their culinary masterpiece?)

Of course, not every meal is going to be chef-quality. So, Horizon offers grab-n-go seating for 7 around its island and peninsula to make quick work of mealtime…in order to maximize beachtime!

Visiting off-season? Enjoy Horizon’s seasonally-heated pool (between October 1 and April 30) at no additional charge.

Want to explore 30A’s famous coastal 17 mile bike path? It couldn’t be any easier! Horizon is located directly on our amazing scenic bike and jogging path.

Don’t want to peddle a bike? No problem! Horizon includes a free, eco-friendly, six seater golf cart to whisk you and your family to any of our world famous restaurants and eclectic boutiques along Florida’s Emerald Coast! (And, yes, that includes Seaside, Seagrove, Grayton, Blue Mountain, Rosemary and Alys…all of which are within just a few miles of Horizon’s central location.)

Ever wanted to try paddleboarding? Did you know that our beaches are home to rare Coastal Dune lakes that are found in only three places in the world? Sadly, very few area visitors ever experience the jaw-dropping serenity of paddling through the quiet waters of these natural wonders because they don’t have the means to enjoy them. But that’s no worry for Horizon guests.

Simply strap the two free included paddleboards on our six-seater golf cart to experience one of our Coastal Dune lakes that is only a mile from Horizon.

This is your opportunity to create memories with family and friends that you will cherish forever. Don’t rent just another beach house. Let us welcome to to Horizon’s coastal experience!

Horizon has parking for up to 4 mid size cars. Parking spaces are approximately 9’ x 20’ each.

Important Information:
NOTE: Check in time is 4:00 PM CST. Check out time is 10:00 AM CST. Our staff needs time to properly clean, sanitize, inspect and maintain the property. Because the property is extremely heavily booked we are unable to offer early check ins, late check outs, early parking or luggage drop offs.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have anything shipped or mailed (through a carrier such as USPS, UPS, or Fedex) to the property. Please be aware that the property does not have postal service and your packages will most likely be returned by the carrier.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have local deliveries (such as baby gear, beach chairs/gear, groceries, golf carts) made prior to their check-in time of 4:00 PM CST and are not permitted to have local pick-ups made after their check-out time of 10:00 AM CST.

NOTE: If you would like to reserve more than 11 months in advance, you must use the VRBO website, rather than the VRBO app. The VRBO app only shows the calendar for up to 11 months which means that it can only be used for reservations less than a year away. Parties or events not allowed Thanks!

NOTE: This property is available for vacation rental only. Parties are prohibited.

NOTE: AGE REQUIREMENTS. You must be at least 25 years old to reserve
during Spring Break. Sorry, no exceptions.

NOTE: Sorry, no pets. No emotional support animals (ESA). No exceptions. Many of our Guests have pet allergies and rely on us to provide a pet free environment. Bringing a pet or an emotional support animal (ESA) is a violation of your booking agreement that will result in the cancellation of your reservation without refund.

NOTE: The property has an exterior security camera(s) that face the driveway and/or entrance and smoke detectors throughout the property. Tampering with the exterior security camera(s) or smoke detector on the property is a violation of the booking agreement. Guests will be charged a $500 fine for tampering with the security camera(s) or smoke detector(s) and the reservation will be cancelled immediately without a refund.

NOTE: For the safety of our Guests, our golf cart has an Apple Airtag in order to facilitate our ability to assist in the event of an accident or mechanical failure. As a result, Apple Iphone users may occasionally receive Airtag notifications while operating the golf cart.

NOTE: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the house. This includes cigarettes, cigars, marijuana, etc. A $500-1000 additional cleaning charge will be added to remove the smell of smoke from the house.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Our family really enjoyed this spacious and beautiful home. The open area of the kitchen, dining and family room accommodated us very well. 
The golf cart really came in handy for our many trips to Seaside and visiting the ice cream shops for our nightly fix of desserts. 
The covered pool was enjoyed by everybody….cool and refreshing!
The elevator was a plus as we were coming and going. 
Our family would definitely consider staying here again and the representative Todd was always available if we had any questions. .

reviews.text: We had four families for spring break. Location is amazing bc close to things but not in the chaos of 30A “squares”. Beach is not crowded here too bc around so many gated/private areas. Pool was great covered especially with dicey weather. Communication is not personal but we did have an issue with TV and they were super fast to respond. The kitchen could use a few more cookware for big crowds, but we made it work. Fun to cook in with two fish markets close by. Golf cart was nice too and walking trails right behind are fantastic!
